Static.helpText: Find quick answers about purchases, vouchers and refunds.
Static.termsText: These terms explain the rules for using the marketplace and purchasing vouchers.
Static.privacyText: We collect only the information needed to operate, secure and improve the service.

helpFaq.q: How do I buy a voucher?
helpFaq.a: Pick a deal, choose the option and quantity, and tap “Buy now”. Sign in with your phone number and complete the payment. The voucher appears in “My vouchers” right away.

helpFaq.q: How do I use a voucher?
helpFaq.a: Visit the business and show the cashier the QR code or the XXXX-XXXX code from “My vouchers”. The cashier checks the code and marks the voucher as used.

helpFaq.q: How long is a voucher valid?
helpFaq.a: The validity is shown on each deal page. A voucher is valid until 23:59 on its last day (Tashkent time). A multi-use voucher works until the final visit.
An unused voucher is refunded automatically within 14 days of payment. After 14 days, send a request and our support team will review it.

helpFaq.q: What if the business refuses my voucher?
helpFaq.a: Tap “Report a problem” on the voucher page or write to us. The business’s payout is held until the dispute is resolved.

helpFaq.q: How do I add my business to Dealo?
helpFaq.a: Fill in the application on the “Add your business” page and upload your documents. After review you can publish deals.

termsSections.title: 1. General
termsSections.body: Dealo is a platform that sells discounted offers from local Tashkent businesses as vouchers. By using the site you agree to these terms.

termsSections.title: 2. Account and sign-in
termsSections.body: You sign in only with your phone number and an SMS code. You are responsible for keeping your account and phone secure. Never share the code.

termsSections.title: 3. Purchase and payment
termsSections.body: Prices are in UZS. A voucher is issued once payment succeeds. The title, price and terms at the time of purchase are kept; later changes do not affect your voucher.

termsSections.title: 4. Using a voucher
termsSections.body: A voucher can be used only at the business that owns the deal and within the stated period. It cannot be exchanged for cash. Visit times depend on the business’s schedule.

termsSections.title: 5. Refunds
termsSections.body: An unused voucher is refunded automatically within 14 days of payment. Later requests and disputes are reviewed by our support team.

termsSections.title: 6. For businesses
termsSections.body: The business is responsible for the accuracy of its deal and the quality of its service. After a voucher is redeemed, Dealo keeps its commission and pays the rest to the business.

termsSections.title: 7. Liability and changes
termsSections.body: Dealo is an intermediary; the service itself is provided by the business. We may update these terms; a new version takes effect on the day it is published on the site.

privacySections.title: 1. What we collect
privacySections.body: Your phone number, name, purchase and voucher history, your reviews, and technical data needed for security (IP address, device type).

privacySections.title: 2. Why we use it
privacySections.body: To sign you in, process purchases, check vouchers, issue refunds, prevent fraud and improve the service.

privacySections.title: 3. Who we share it with
privacySections.body: A business sees only what it needs to redeem your voucher. Payment and SMS providers receive the data they need to deliver their service. We do not sell your data.

privacySections.title: 4. How long we keep it
privacySections.body: Data is kept while your account is active and for the accounting periods required by law.

privacySections.title: 5. Your rights
privacySections.body: You can ask to see or correct your data and to delete your account. Write to our support team to do so.

privacySections.title: 6. Security
privacySections.body: Data travels over encrypted connections, staff access is limited by role, and sensitive actions are recorded in an audit log.
